text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the "Tokyo Yushun (Japanese 
Derby)" has finally arrived. Mejiro Ardan 
expresses her gratitude for supporting her 
and walking this path together to get 
here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Determined to present her Trainer with the 
title of Derby Trainer, she headed out to 
the stage of destiny.
